vibe_rationale: Community-trusted crew throwing curated daytime open airs at heritage sites; a single ticketed scene.
fit_notes: Adult (18+), daytime garden crowd that follows a long-running house DJ duo, so a hydration or recovery presence suits the daytime format better than late-night clubs. Small and ticketed, so the route is a collaboration rather than a sponsorship. No website or partnership contact was found, and the one sponsor (a gin brand) is unverified.
